client_decisions.decision: Exclude shirt fabric, body, lighting, folds, and photographic perspective from the recovered artwork.
Do not classify the result as print-ready when fidelity or colour evidence is insufficient.

locked_items: Owl artwork identity and major component arrangement
Three printed colour roles: dark blue, rust orange, and warm taupe
Transparent background with no garment or body pixels
Three-state verdict vocabulary: print_ready, manual_review, insufficient_source

changed_items.change: Removed all photographic and garment content; retained only reconstructed artwork geometry.
Normalized perspective, fabric distortion, and paired-feature symmetry while preserving the supported silhouette.
Replaced uneven photographic colour variation with three provisional flat fills.
Used one simplified, clearly supported transparent glint per pupil and omitted ambiguous secondary marks.
Modeled light gaps as transparency; preview alone simulates a white substrate.

unresolved_blockers: Human approval of normalized geometry and small-detail simplifications
Decision on garment knockout versus white ink/underbase
Production-size test print and registration approval
